source: Cloudflare API (read-only): workers/scripts, workers/domains, workers/durable_objects/namespaces, queues, containers/applications + instances-v2
privacy: exact per-release instance names/placements are intentionally NOT enumerated here — company-hosted operations are private (AGENTS.md); ownership is asserted by naming patterns + counts

mikka-api.model: release-per-worker, ingress worker + container application per release

mikka-eve.notes: Eve runtime workers; mikka-eve-candidate is the CF container+DO host (never idles by code); mikka-eve-relay-* front the relay path

idle_policy.BusinessApi (mikka-api-*): sleepAfter='5m' (cloudflare/api/ingress/worker.mjs:12) — warm at snapshot does NOT prove always-on
idle_policy.mikka-cloud-services: UNVERIFIED — container class source lives in the service repo, not this one
idle_policy.eve-runtime host (CF container DO): onActivityExpired(){} no-op + onStop auto-restart (cloudflare/eve-runtime/src/index.mjs); deployed as CF worker + EveRuntime DO + container (cloudflare/eve-runtime/wrangler.jsonc) — genuinely never idles

queues.consumers: every live events/outbox/control queue has exactly 1 consumer + 1 producer; dead/dlq queues have none — no orphan consumers
